subject.title: [Feature]: CLI command to list pending exec approval requests

question: Should the refreshed approvals CLI expose only authorized pending inspection, or also allow approvals to be resolved from the terminal?
rationale: Listing is the requested observability feature; resolution creates a new mutating operator surface whose authorization and durable first-answer-wins behavior require maintainer intent.

options.title: Ship read-only listing
options.body: Rebase the linked PR and expose sanitized table and JSON output without terminal resolution.

options.title: Approve list and resolve
options.body: Retain mutating resolution only after live Gateway proof and explicit approval of reviewer authorization and canonical decision semantics.

recommendation.title: Ship read-only listing
recommendation.body: Rebase the linked PR and expose sanitized table and JSON output without terminal resolution.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns the broader durable approval direction and has prior review involvement in this issue.
